text:
Ivy P.: FYI saw some weird duplicate owner assignments during peak yesterday — two SDRs got the same lead within 3s of each other.
Jonas: that's bad. any idea if its HS or our RR service racing?
Rae (SDR): I had LD-7789 pop on my queue twice and both times I clicked claim it showed as available. ended up with duplicate notes.
Lee (ops): quick trace: HS sent assign webhook -> our router tried to claim via SF API while a near-simultaneous HS retry also triggered. no claim-lease so both attempts looked free for a short window.
Ivy P.: propose adding a short-lived claim lease on the lead object before final owner assignment. flow: set property `claim_lease_id` + `claim_lease_expiry` and only owner-assignment proceeds if lease matches.
Jonas: +1 and add dedupe key: compute `handoff_hash = sha256(lead_id + enrichment_version)` so retries don't create new attempts.
Rae (SDR): will that prevent me seeing duplicates in HS activity? sometimes those duplicates confuse SDRs.
Lee (ops): yes — we'll also change the UI timeline to collapse events with same `handoff_hash` and show "retry merged" note. small UX tweak.
Ivy P.: SLA change: treat lease expiry as soft window: if claim_lease_expiry > now -> block assign; if expiry passed, allow one final claim attempt then mark fallback after ttl. default lease=8s, ttl fallback=15m.
handoff-bot: Rule created: alert #marketing if duplicate_assignments_rate > 0.5% for 10m. (rule id: HB-7812)
Jonas: canary plan: implement lease + dedupe in router behind flag, enable for 5% traffic for 1h, monitor `duplicate_assignments_rate` and `claim_wait_errors`. rollback if duplicates do not drop.
Rae (SDR): small request: when fallback triggers, add activity note "Moved to fallback pool due to claim lease expiry" with timestamp so SDRs know why.
Lee (ops): putting together a tiny runbook and cURL examples for test: `curl -X POST /internal/handoff/lease -d '{"lead":"LD-123","lease":"abc","expiry":"2026-06-01T12:00:00Z"}'` returns 200/409 semantics. will attach to PR.
Ivy P.: awesome. Jonas, please add unit test for racing claims and a short e2e sim. Rae, we'll wire the timeline UX update with product. reconvene after canary. :thumbsup:
